deliverable: kaggle_pipeline: End-to-end Kaggle training + submission pipeline — A CLI/script that trains on train.csv, writes OOF/CV metrics, predicts on test.csv, and produces a submission.csv with columns PassengerId,Transported (boolean or string matching the competition format). Includes preprocessing, feature engineering from Cabin/PassengerId/Name, and a tunable model.
metric: accuracy: Accuracy (higher is better) — Official Spaceship Titanic competition metric; submissions are scored by fraction of correct Transported labels.
cv_grouping: GroupKFold / group-aware stratified folds by PassengerId group (recommended)
compute_budget: Light: few models, default-ish params, minutes (recommended)

protocol.quick: Stratified k-fold (e.g. 5-fold) CV on train.csv only, reporting mean±std accuracy. Optionally group folds by PassengerId group prefix to reduce within-group leakage. Agent may see full train labels and CV scores; keep no held-out slice at this stage.
protocol.validation: Hold out a fixed stratified (or group-aware) validation split from train.csv that the agent never tunes against iteratively as a pseudo-leaderboard; evaluate accuracy once after model selection on CV. Hide this holdout's labels from repeated agent feedback to limit overfitting to a small local set.
protocol.final: Train on all train.csv (or CV-chosen config), predict test.csv, write submission.csv, and score via Kaggle API for competition slug spaceship-titanic. Keep Kaggle public/private leaderboard labels fully hidden from the agent; only return the public score (and optionally private if available) as the final metric. Do not join test labels from any source.
